captions.text: One click drafts the empty cells — using your project's instructions and validated examples.
AI drafts land as suggestions — you review, edit, and validate before anything is final.
Confirm the run — the model drafts the next untranslated cell right in the editor.
Every draft follows the model and drafting context you set in Project Settings.
